theorem: For an LR anchor N=A+Q+B with A<B, 1<=A<=15 and Q-(B-A)<-15, no Leech bi-spider extends the anchor.
trust_boundary: Finite relaxed top-window exhaustion. The search retains unique long-tip offsets and internal distances as separate necessary collision classes, while omitting parameter-dependent cross-class collisions, all other vertices and the vertex budget. B=C+16 represents all dominance gaps; C=46 represents the proved C>45 stable tail.
